    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); cells.append((y,x))

            if len(cells)==(y1-y0+1)*(x1-x0+1) and len(cells)>=30:
                for y,x in cells: out[y][x]=4
    return out
''')
